purpose: Supplementary data-by-capacity interaction check, declared after the one-axis development sweep and while its frozen holdout was running; not part of the original seven-condition registration.

data.sampling: Uniform reservoir of public roots, independent of labels; completed games only; no repetitions or positions with five or fewer live pieces
data.teacher_comparison: Identical quiet roots with valid labels at both budgets; cold transposition tables and identical search configuration except time
data.validation: Separate fixed game seeds; quiet validation for checkpoint selection; all-phase metrics also reported
data.validation_target: 640ms labels on the same valid quiet validation roots for every condition; full-distribution 160ms phase diagnostics do not select checkpoints

training.objective: Scalar sigmoid value cross entropy plus drift and weight regularization
training.coverage_comparison: Match the small condition's row count without replacement; allocate as evenly as available across 0, 1-7, and 8+ hidden pieces; permit tactical roots and roots whose searched best move is a flip
training.capacity: Zero-initialized additive public piece-composition lookup tables; same initial integer scores at every tier
training.selection: For each condition select its seed by lowest common quiet validation value loss; initial checkpoint remains eligible
training.matched_quiet_rows: The small, capacity, bound, and teacher conditions use identical quiet roots with valid labels at both budgets. Data4x contains these rows plus quiet roots from the additional 1536 games.
training.capacity_layout: Medium: 8 hidden-count phases and 45 feasible predator-count cells across seven piece types. Large adds 5 hidden-count phases with revealed/hidden piece-versus-enemy-count tables; the impossible fully-revealed/hidden-piece group is omitted.

evaluation.winner: Highest time-budget development score; then lower validation value loss; then lexical condition name
evaluation.claims: Development comparisons are exploratory; final frozen-candidate superiority claims use fresh deals and report all predetermined tests without optional stopping
evaluation.seed_blocks: Training seeds receive disjoint consecutive deal blocks, shared across conditions; aggregate each condition over all three seeds. Final seed selected only by validation loss.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Frozen selected model versus current structured model at 25ms; other final comparisons secondary with pointwise intervals

compute.colab: Conditional on measured training cost; L4 only, at most one owned runtime, at most 90 minutes allocated; no automatic alternative GPU
compute.queue: 6 fits, 6 time-budget development matches, 6 node-budget matches, and at most 2 frozen final matches

supplement.advance_rule: Only if a new condition strictly exceeds the original small condition aggregate 25ms development score; tie retains the original selection. Choose its training seed by common validation loss only.
supplement.stopping_rule: Exactly two new conditions, three training seeds each, 720 development games. At most two 800-game fresh holdouts. No optional stopping or additional hyperparameter tuning.
